name: Braids
description: Macro oscillator module based on Mutable Instruments Braids by Emilie Gillet, ported from Schwung DSP. Reads Push 3's own pad MIDI and renders audio into push-audio-loopback's virtual card. On-screen I/O picker (Shift+Device, page 3) lets you pick which MIDI port to read, which audio device to render to, and which channel pair. Needs push-audio-loopback (waits for it at startup and after every restart) and push-manager + push-display for its on-screen controls.
author: federico-pepe
